question: Who among the following wrote the book ‘India Wins Freedom’ giving an insider’s view of India’s freedom struggle?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maulana Abul Kalam Azad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​****​**Maulana Abul Kalam Azad **wrote the book ‘India Wins Freedom’.**
 
• The book India Wins Freedom gives **a detailed description and analysis of the meaning of 'Pakistan', the formation of India and the partition of India.**
 
• ** The book "India Wins Freedom"** is **one of his books which narrates and narrates the utmost importance of history and events which are still kept hidden and treasured on the safe side of the contemporary relevance of the nation.**
 
• **"India Wins Freedom" was written by Azad's personal secretary "Humayun Khan",** which was scrutinized closely by Maulana Abdul Kalam Azad before being brought into the domain of the general public.
 
• Maulana Abul Kalam **was one of the most influential freedom fighters during the freedom struggle of independent India.**
 
• He was also a** noted writer, poet and journalist.**
 
• He was **a prominent political leader of the Indian National Congress and was elected as Congress President in 1923 and 1940.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**

 
 
• **​**Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel **was a senior leader of the Indian National Congress and a prominent figure in the Indian freedom struggle.**
 
• Later became** the first Deputy Prime Minister of India and the first Home Minister.​**
 
 
 
• **Dr BR Ambedkar**
 
 
• **​**Dr BR Ambedkar was popularly known as Babasaheb Ambedkar and everyone knows that **he was one of the architects of the Indian Constitution.**
 
• He was also **a noted political leader, eminent jurist, Buddhist activist, philosopher, anthropologist, historian, orator, writer, economist, scholar and editor.​**
 
 
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru**
 
 
• **​**Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru** was the first Prime Minister of India and a key figure in the Indian independence struggle and the process of political development in the country after independence.**
